title: Constrained Multi-Relational Graphons with Maximum Entropy
summary: The principle of maximum entropy provides a fundamental framework for characterizing typical structures of large random networks subject to observable constraints. In their pioneering numerical experiments \cite{radin2014asymptotics}, Radin, Ren, and Sadun conjectured that entropy-maximizing graphons satisfying subgraph density constraints are stochastic block models a conjecture we term the RRS conjecture.
